meta.parties: Bandulhamy Et Al. v. Tikirihamy Et Al

rules.statement: The plaintiffs are declared entitled to an undivided 1/12th and 1/72nd of the field, as well as leasehold rights under P 6.
rules.supporting_quote: "The plaintiffs are accordingly declared entitled to an undivided l/12th and l/72nd of this field. They are also declared entitled to open pits and excavate for gems. They are also entitled to the leasehold rights under P 6."
